title: 怨情
author: 李白
intro: A beautiful woman rolls up a bead curtain, sits frowning, and cries — but whom is she angry with? Twenty characters that show a feeling without ever explaining it.
analysis: 这首诗像一幅人物画：一位美丽的女子卷起珠帘，向外张望，好像在等什么人；等不到，就静静地坐了很久，皱起了眉头。接着我们看见她脸上湿湿的泪痕——可是她到底在恨谁呢？诗人说“不知”。题目叫“怨情”，全诗却没有一个字直接写她的心事，只写了卷帘、深坐、皱眉、流泪几个动作，留给读者自己去猜：也许是丈夫远行不归，也许是被心上人冷落。这种“只写外表、不说内心”的写法叫含蓄，话说得少，意思反而更多。最后一句用问句结束，让人读完还在回味。
analysisEn: The poem is like a portrait. A lovely woman rolls up a curtain of pearls and looks out, as if waiting for someone. No one comes, so she sits a long time, and her fine eyebrows draw together in a frown. Then we notice the wet streaks of tears on her face. Whom does she resent? “I don’t know,” says the poet. The title promises “resentment,” yet not one word tells us what she is thinking. We only see a few actions — rolling up the curtain, sitting, frowning, crying — and must guess the rest ourselves: perhaps a husband who has been away too long, perhaps a lover who has turned cold. Chinese critics call this hánxù (“holding back”): saying less so that the reader feels more. Ending on an unanswered question keeps the poem alive after the last word. It also shows a quieter side of Li Bai, better known for wine, mountains and the moon.
background: Li Bai (701–762), the “Immortal of Poetry”, wrote many poems in the voice of lonely women, a popular genre in Tang poetry. The date and occasion of this one are unknown.
pronunciation: 颦 pín（皱眉），生僻字。卷 juǎn（卷起）。蛾眉 é méi。谁：诗词里传统读 shuí，现代普通话也可读 shéi，网站按 shuí 注音。
version: 采用通行的选本文本（《唐诗三百首》等），与维基文库《全唐诗》本一致。“颦”一作“蹙”，“但见”一作“但觉”，网站不用。

lines.lit: A beautiful woman rolls up the pearl curtain;
lines.en: A lovely woman rolls up the pearl-bead curtain,

lines.lit: sitting long, she knits her moth-like eyebrows.
lines.en: sits on and on, her fine brows drawn in a frown.
All you can see are the damp tracks of tears —

lines.lit: one does not know whom her heart resents.
lines.en: but whom does her heart blame? No one can tell.

words.note: 现代汉语也说，书面一点。

words.en: a curtain of pearls or beads
words.note: 古代富贵人家的门帘、窗帘；今天说“珠帘”仍懂，但少用。

words.en: to sit for a long time
words.note: “深”指时间长，不是“深处”；现代汉语说“坐了很久”。

words.en: to frown; to knit the brows
words.note: 生僻字，现代汉语说“皱眉”；成语“一颦一笑”还在用。

words.en: fine, curved eyebrows (like a moth’s feelers)
words.note: 古代形容美女细长弯曲的眉毛，也代指美女。
古义“只”；今天的“但”多表示“但是”。
古诗里的“恨”常是“怨、遗憾”，比现代汉语的“恨”轻。

imagery.name: 泪
imagery.zh: 泪痕是全诗唯一透露心事的地方，却不说为谁而流。
imagery.en: The tear-stains are the only clue to her feelings — yet they never say who they are for.
